title: GREAT LAKES SURFACE WATER TEMPERATURE
source_name: NOAA/GLERL CoastWatch GLSEA (Great Lakes Surface Environmental Analysis)
variable: lake surface water temperature (satellite-derived AVHRR/VIIRS composite)
ocean_source_name: NOAA CoastWatch Geo-Polar Blended SST Analysis, Diurnal Correction (Day+Night), GHRSST NRT Global 5 km Daily (analysed_sst, degree_C)
ocean_variable: analysed_sst (degree_C, valid -2..40; _FillValue -327.68) gated by mask water bit (1=water; 0 fill excluded); sea-ice cells retained as valid cold water
ocean_precedence: NOAA/GLERL CoastWatch GLSEA wins everywhere valid inside the Great Lakes rectangle (blended-SST cells there excluded from ocean/lake percentile populations to avoid double-counting); blended SST owns all other valid water
lake_source_note: Continental Lake Coverage uses the same blended-SST valid-water cells that fall on inland water (global_landonly == 1) plus GLSEA Great Lakes cells. Lakes below the ~5 km analysis resolution are documented gaps, not fabricated. Copernicus CLMS Lake Surface Water Temperature NRT 1 km 10-daily (Sentinel-3 SLSTR, CDSE access) investigated as a future inland-lake source; not integrated (anonymous-CI access path unavailable; 10-day synthesis latency vs daily refresh; lake-inventory verification pending).
continental_gaps_note: Sub-resolution small lakes, rivers, and blended-SST land-masked cells render transparent (never interpolated, never zero-filled).
